text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer came to an end, welcoming the 
autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. There's no inflammation. You 
should have no problem running in the 
Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, please continue to exercise ample 
caution.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Understood, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The inflammation in her legs successfully 
subsided, and the days were spent steadily 
preparing for the race――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as the day approached for the 
final curtain to at last rise...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Huff, huff, haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...! One more time...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Cesario's distant gaze, I saw 
Air Messiah pushing herself to her 
absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Hah, hah, hah, hah!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Messiah-san. ...Would you like 
to take a short break together?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, you even treated me to my 
share.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No. I just noticed that you've been 
pushing yourself extremely hard in your 
training lately.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This might be meddlesome of me, but I was 
a little worried.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san. ...Would you, please listen 
to me?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Neither this year's Oka Sho nor the 
Oaks saw me perform at the level I had 
hoped for."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As if to prove the true strength running 
in this blood—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A performance that would prove she is 
"stronger and more magnificent than anyone 
else."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Cesario-san. I respect you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Enough to feel a twinge of panic when I 
heard she was returning to the domestic 
front.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However—even if that's true, I must bet 
everything on the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win the Shuka Sho. I want to 
break away from my past self."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I must press forward. For 
Mother's sake, and for my own... without 
fail."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Therefore—the Shuka Sho is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind the polite words and round glasses— 
those eyes burned with pure, intense 
passion.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I intend to take on this challenge, 
wagering all that I am.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The one standing in my path is none other 
than you, "Cesario".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I won't let you pass ahead. ...Never.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Please keep the above in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well then. Thank you for the cafe latte.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Could you look into Messiah especially 
thoroughly in preparation for the Shuka 
Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah's fighting spirit across many 
races is well-known throughout the 
Umamusume world. She will surely be a 
formidable rival in the Shuka Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario should know that full well, and 
yet—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Messiah-san right now is 
definitely different from how she was 
before.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she'll be fully primed for the 
Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—the day of the Shuka Sho finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. That's more than enough for our 
final checks. Thank you for the research."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will always keep a close eye on 
Messiah-san's movements. First, we need 
one win.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Taking a step that leads to a distant 
future. Well then, I'm off...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the road ahead is still 
unclear. That is precisely why I want to 
illuminate it with a victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stage was set in autumn, amidst 
falling leaves. She headed toward the turf 
to claim the final tiara of the Triple 
Tiara.
